def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not girl_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    girl_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in girl_patches]
    shirt_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in shirt_patches]
    
    best_match = None
    min_distance = float('inf')
    
    for girl_center in girl_centers:
        for shirt_center in shirt_centers:
            dx = abs(girl_center[0] - shirt_center[0])
            dy = abs(girl_center[1] - shirt_center[1])
            distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy
            
            if distance_squared < min_distance:
                min_distance = distance_squared
                best_match = shirt_patches[shirt_centers.index(shirt_center)]
    
    return best_match
